subject: atom-0040
title: Goal Controller classification lacks risk and budget behavior
details: High-end Goal Controller classification should include objective, scope, constraints, authority/write surface, risk, budget, expected evidence, and completion criteria; GRS-026 covers objective/scope/authority/evidence/completion broadly but risk and budget only appear as metadata/projection fields.

subject: atom-0045
